turns.prompt_text: Can you explain to me the difference between watts and Watt hours Learning coach was used in this chat. Manage your Gems.
turns.response_html:
That's a great question! It can be confusing because the terms sound so similar, but they actually measure two very different things. In a nutshell, watts measure power, which is the rate at which energy is used, while watt-hours measure energy, which is the total amount of energy used over a period of time.

To put it in an analogy, think of a car:

  • Watts are like the car's speed (how fast it's going at a single moment).
  • Watt-hours are like the distance the car travels (how far it went over a period of time).

Let's break this down further so we can really get a handle on it.

Learning plan:

  1. Understanding Watts (Power)
  2. Understanding Watt-Hours (Energy)
  3. The Relationship Between Watts and Watt-Hours

By the end of this, you'll be able to tell the difference between these two and even figure out how much energy your own devices use!
